entry_text: JacORB is a Java implementation of the CORBA object request broker architecture for distributed object communication.
example: A Java client uses JacORB to invoke an operation on a remote CORBA object.
label: JacORB

sources.note: The project guide describes a Java CORBA object request broker for distributed object communication.
